reason: We'd probably spin up the free trial on a whim, but half of how my co-founder and I actually coordinate is voice notes on WhatsApp, and nothing here says it handles that, so the chat would sit empty and we'd drift back. Paying $20 a month on top of what we already use free doesn't happen for a tool we've stopped opening.
objection: $20 a month is more than we pay now for a stack that already works, and it doesn't replace the voice-note habit where our real decisions happen.
would_change_my_mind: If it took voice notes natively and turned them into tasks or notes, so it could actually replace WhatsApp for us instead of adding another place to check.
